title.zh: 温度时间地图：峰温相同，结果也可能完全不同
title.en: Temperature–time map: identical peak temperatures can produce very different results

subtitle.zh: 峰值温度、有效时间、升降温与热穿透共同决定热预算
subtitle.en: Peak temperature, effective time, heating / cooling and thermal penetration jointly determine the thermal budget

body.zh: 热预算不是简单的“温度×时间”；反应、扩散和缺陷演化对温度通常呈强烈非线性。
body.en: The thermal budget is not simply “temperature × time”; reaction, diffusion and defect evolution usually depend strongly and nonlinearly on temperature.

body.zh: 温度-时间工程地图（同一峰温，不同轨迹）
body.en: Temperature–time engineering map (same peak, different trajectories)

body.zh: 炉管：缓慢升降温＋长平台
body.en: Furnace: Slow heating / cooling + long plateau

body.zh: RTP Soak：快速升温＋短平台
body.en: RTP Soak: Rapid heating + short plateau

body.zh: Spike：尖峰、近零刻意驻留
body.en: Spike: A sharp peak with almost no intentional dwell

body.zh: Flash：毫秒级窄脉冲
Laser：局部超快脉冲/扫描
温度时间
晶圆深度剖面（相对趋势示意）炉管/Soak→热进入更深、体内更接近平衡
body.en: Wafer-depth profiles (relative trends) Furnace / Soak → heat penetrates deeper, And the bulk approaches equilibrium

body.zh: Flash/Laser→表层瞬态升温、热穿透更浅
body.en: Flash / Laser → transient surface heating, With shallower thermal penetration

body.zh: 注意：以上为相对趋势，非固定深度。
body.en: Note: these are relative trends, not fixed depths.

body.zh: 热处理选型流程（六步法）
定义目标反应
设定材料温度上限
设定有效驻留区间
检查Ramp Up/Down
评估热扩散深度
比较候选方案
关键可控参数（四张控制卡）
峰值温度决定反应驱动力与部分缺陷活化概率。
body.en: Peak temperature Determines the reaction driving force and Some defect-activation probabilities.

body.zh: 阈值以上有效时间直接影响反应量、扩散与缺陷演化。
body.en: Effective time above The threshold Directly affects reaction extent, Diffusion and defect evolution.

body.zh: Ramp与Quench影响热穿透、热应力与尾巴贡献。
body.en: Ramp and Quench Affect thermal penetration, Thermal stress and the tail contribution.

body.zh: 吸收率/发射率与热穿透决定能量耦合效率与热在材料中的分布。
body.en: Absorptivity / emissivity And thermal penetration Determine energy-coupling efficiency and Heat distribution within the material.

body.zh: 耦合与权衡（趋势判断）
时间更短→扩散更少，但可能需要更高峰温；
body.en: Shorter time → Less diffusion, But a higher peak may be required;

body.zh: 峰温更高→反应更快，但均匀性与材料兼容风险上升。
body.en: Higher peak temperature → Faster reaction, But greater uniformity and material- Compatibility risks.

body.zh: 冷却尾巴也会贡献热预算
body.en: The cooling tail also contributes to the thermal budget

body.zh: 主要风险点温度量测偏差影响真实热预算的判断。
body.en: Principal risks Temperature-measurement bias Affects assessment of the actual Thermal budget.

body.zh: 局部过热引发缺陷、相变或界面异常。
body.en: Local overheating Causes defects, phase changes Or interfacial anomalies.

body.zh: Pattern Loading导致局部温度与反应差异。
body.en: Pattern Loading Causes local temperature And reaction differences.

body.zh: 热应力/翘曲影响形稳、CD与良率稳定性。
body.en: Thermal stress / warpage Affects shape stability, CD And yield stability.

body.zh: 量测反馈与闭环优化
热电偶（工艺参考）
高温计/发射率
Rs Map（均匀性）
薄膜相（结构与化学）
数据反馈更新模型优化候选温度轨迹
body.en: Data feedback Update the model Optimize candidate Temperature trajectories

body.zh: 下游影响（关键指标）
结深（或扩散深度）
界面反应层（厚度/成分）
应力（内应力变化）
后续热预算余量（工艺窗口）
分钟、秒、毫秒、纳秒仅用于相对分类，不能直接当作量产Recipe窗口。
body.en: Minutes, seconds, milliseconds and nanoseconds are only relative categories; they cannot be used directly as production Recipe windows.

notes.zh: 温度图标题写“同一峰温”，各示意峰高存在视觉差异。忠实保留图形；本图没有数值标定，不推定等峰温数值。
notes.en: The source title says “same peak,” but the schematic peak heights differ visually. Preserve the original geometry; the chart has no numerical calibration, so no equal peak values are inferred.

uncertain: 温度图标题写“同一峰温”，各示意峰高存在视觉差异。忠实保留图形；本图没有数值标定，不推定等峰温数值。
